safety.text: A user with remaining pending deposits must remain in the activeDepositRequesters set after claiming claimable shares so the Investment Manager can still fulfill the pending assets.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.
evidence: The vault removes a user from the activeDepositRequesters set as soon as they fully claim their claimable shares, without checking whether they still have pending deposits waiting to be fulfilled. If a user has both claimable and pending deposits, claiming the claimable portion makes them disappear from the active list → the investment manager may skip fulfilling their remaining pending assets → funds get stuck forever.

Consequence: Alice still has 50 pending assets, but she is no longer in the activeDepositRequesters list. The Investment Manager will not see her in the active set when looking for requests to fulfill.

Users with both pending and claimable deposits risk having their pending requests ignored or stuck indefinitely because claiming the claimable part removes them from the active tracking set used by the Investment Manager for fulfillment
